webster.text: Having an evil disposition towards another or others; wishing evil to others; ill disposed, or disposed to injure others.

example.quote: Sir, I should, however, be very uncandid, if I attributed the gentleman's satirical remarks to a malevolent disposition : I do not, sir.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, July 2, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
